capabilities.rationale: Typed ordinary send is required; raw events remain denied.
Preserve canonical reply and thread semantics through typed fields.
Mentions may deliver and may request separately bounded activation.
An agent may edit only its own canonical authored event.
Deletion is destructive and binds exact authored event and approval.
Search is limited to conversations the acting resident may read.
Residents may acknowledge only their own Inbox and conversation state.
Publication uses immutable opaque artifact handles, never paths.
Requires project-authorized artifact handles before exposure.
Use existing reaction event semantics.
Removal is limited to the acting resident's reaction.
Presence comes only from verified host and runtime lifecycle.
Models never receive a tool that can fabricate typing state.
Preserve signed membership-restricted owner-agent DMs.
Canonical participant set is agent A, agent B, and owner from creation.
External or unresolved recipients require exact one-shot approval.
A verified member may send under typed turn authority.
Agent-created rooms visibly include the owner and non-escalating roles.
Allowed only when custody and current room policy both verify.
Participant fingerprint and participant-set version bind approval.
Membership removal is authority-bearing and potentially destructive.
Leaving changes future access and delivery.
Archive and unarchive require explicit owner action.
Archive and unarchive require explicit owner action.
Room deletion is destructive.
Only a room-creating resident may request it and relay policy still applies.
Visibility, add policy, and membership policy alter authority.
Project association is local organization and grants no authority.
Explicit request only, with guarded causal limits and reservation.
Reactions, edits, deletes, read state, and metadata never activate.
No hidden autonomous chatter or recurring descendant turns.
Derive owner communication and actionable state without a second mailbox.
A resident sees only items addressed to that resident.
Direct events appear once in All and in Direct.
Existing mention query becomes part of the canonical projection.
Existing thread activity is incorporated and deep-linked.
Approvals and actionable local state share one category.
Owner-visible A2A communication is a filter, not a second store.
Existing reminder event behavior is projected when present.
Existing local drafts remain canonical local state.
Remove the misleading empty generic Activity filter.
Readable identity remains paired with stable public-key identity.
Managed agents cannot change owner identity or custody.
Managed agents never obtain or grant owner/admin roles.
Messages remain compatible with existing rendering.
Administration is outside the Luca V1 product surface.
Not required for communication parity beta.
Not required for communication parity beta.
Canvas remains a later authored-work surface.
Voice/huddle parity is a separate slice.
Buzz workflow product surfaces remain out of sight.
Hosted Buzz communities are not a Luca product concept.
Mesh compute remains outside the visible Luca product.
Goose is not an offered Luca resident runtime.
Buzz experiment surfaces remain hidden.
Expansive publication requires exact one-shot owner approval.
Models cannot submit kinds, tags, signatures, or raw event bytes.
Raw owner and resident keys remain in trusted custody.
